narr: During the afternoon strong to severe thunderstorms formed over Northwest Kansas. Wind gusts of 60 MPH were reported near Leoti. Later in the afternoon hail up to golf ball size was reported in the Angelus and Menlo area. Prolonged rainfall north of Russell Springs caused water to flow over Highway 25 that was deep enough traffic had to be diverted.
ev: Water reported over the highway at CR Seneca and Highway 25 and CR Topeka and Highway 25 intersections. Traffic was diverted due to water on the highway.
lsr: EM REPORTED WATER OVER ROADWAY AT K25/SENECA AND K25/TOPEKA (MM 160-161) WITH A PERIOD OF TRAFFIC DIVERSIONS. WATER HAS SINCE RECEDED.
